subject: a lean, wiry Italian Renaissance sculptor with a broad flattened nose, short dark curly hair and a short dark forked beard, deep-set intent eyes, wearing a plain dark wool work tunic, a leather apron and boots, hands and clothes dusted with white marble powder

panels.01-settignano: a small Italian boy of six in a simple tunic sitting on a stone wall in a hillside quarry village near Florence in 1481, watching stonecutters split grey stone blocks with hammers and chisels, chips of stone on the ground, olive trees and Tuscan hills beyond, warm morning light, wide establishing feeling
panels.02-faun: a fourteen-year-old Italian boy in a plain tunic in a Renaissance Florentine garden full of weathered ancient marble fragments in 1489, carefully chiselling a small rough block of marble on a workbench, a dignified older man in a rich red Florentine robe and cap standing behind him smiling with amusement, cypress trees, sunlight
panels.03-block: a young {S} in his twenties in 1501 standing on a rough wooden scaffold beside a towering, still-uncut column of white marble in a walled Florentine cathedral workshop yard, striking a chisel with a mallet, only rough tool marks and chipped stone visible on the block, no finished figure, clouds of marble dust in slanting sunlight, workmen with ropes below
panels.04-scaffold: {S} in 1508 standing high on a tall stepped wooden scaffold just beneath a great curved plaster vault, head tilted far back, painting with a brush held up overhead, paint drips on his face and beard, buckets of plaster and pots of pigment on the planks, only bare wet plaster and faint charcoal guide lines visible on the vault, no recognisable painted scenes, a helper grinding colours on the boards below, dramatic light from high chapel windows, vertigo perspective looking up
panels.05-siege: a middle-aged {S} in 1529 on the earthen ramparts of a hill above Florence, unrolling a drawn plan of fortifications for a group of workmen with shovels and baskets of earth building bastions, the domes and towers of the city in the distance, tense but determined mood, no fighting
panels.06-dome: an older {S} with a grey beard in a long dark cloak in Rome in 1547, studying a large wooden model of a church dome on a workshop table, master builders leaning in as he points with a pair of compasses, half-built stone walls and wooden cranes visible through an open arch
panels.07-candle: an elderly {S} with a white beard carving a rough marble block alone at night in a bare Roman workshop around 1555, wearing a stiff cap of thick paper with a single lit candle fixed on top that lights the stone, mallet and chisel in hand, marble dust in the air, deep shadows, quiet determination
panels.08-last: a very old, frail but dignified {S} with a thin white beard, wrapped in a heavy dark cloak, in a modest Roman workshop in winter 1564, gently chiselling a tall, slender, unfinished marble block that shows only rough vertical shapes, pale winter light through a small window, a calm and respectful mood
